description: §4.15 (S480) — the reserved cell names are whole names: cells named `dbx`, `schemas`, `mdText` compile, and a CHILD field named `db` of a declaration (`@card.db`) is not a cell and compiles.
rationale: §4.15 reserves the cell names `db`, `schema` and `md` exactly (compared lowercase); a longer name is not one of them, and a child field is not a cell.
